# Commands automatic Rust dependency update and isolated promotion

`commands/graph/dependency-update.mjs` performs fetched compatibility checks, detached paired worktrees, Rust validation/build, guarded fast-forward promotion, primary rebuild, retry state, and cancellation. `getGraphRustUpstreamStatus` accepts custom `commRef`/`firefoxRef`, enabling local `HEAD` comparisons without network access. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
